_about: CodeQL findings accepted on review, carried over from the alerts dismissed on GitHub (code scanning) when the scan moved to scripts/local-ci.cjs. A result whose rule and file match an entry does not fail the codescan gate; it is counted as accepted. Every entry needs a reason; an entry that no longer matches any result is reported as stale. See docs/SECURITY-HARDENING.md, Accepted CodeQL findings.

accepted.reason: won't fix: Local single-user CLI: this reads then writes the invoking user's own config/learnings files in their own tree. No trust boundary or privileged context, so the TOCTOU window is not exploitable.

false positive: Per-uid bridge dir, created 0700 then verified: not a symlink, owned by us, no group/other bits, fail-closed. The name must be predictable - statusline writes it, context-monitor reads it, separate processes; mkdtemp breaks the IPC. CodeQL accepts no sanitizer but randomness.

false positive: Per-uid bridge dir, created 0700 then verified: not a symlink, owned by us, no group/other bits, fail-closed. The name must be predictable - statusline writes it, context-monitor reads it, separate processes; mkdtemp breaks the IPC. CodeQL accepts no sanitizer but randomness.

false positive: Guarded + verified: config-set rejects any key path with __proto__/constructor/prototype (inline check over all segments, early return) before assignment. Tested nested vectors; Object.prototype stays clean. CodeQL flags the path-walk shape, cannot see the guard.

false positive: No HTTP in output(): this writes a local command-result object to a private mkdtemp directory. CodeQL over-approximates a taint path; there is no network-sourced data reaching this sink.

false positive: globToRegex is a glob-to-regex compiler that escapes every regex metacharacter (.+?^$()|{}[] and backslash) before emitting; only intended wildcard translations pass through. Input is a trusted internal glob pattern, not attacker data.

won't fix: Local single-user CLI: this reads then writes the invoking user's own config/learnings files in their own tree. No trust boundary or privileged context, so the TOCTOU window is not exploitable.
